tasks.title: Super Series list shows 'Part 1/2/3...' labels instead of bare topic folders
tasks.notes: IMPLEMENTED+VALIDATED (session-12, 2026-09-13): SeriesScreen (overview) now renders EVERY part of every series as its own row inside the series card — 'Part 1' / 'Part 2' / 'Part 3' ... with its pipeline state (error/cancelled states in error color), tapping a row opens that part's task detail (new onSelectTask: (String)->Unit parameter on SeriesScreen, wired in App.kt composable('series') to navController.navigate('task/{jobId}')). tasks.title: Prompt wording: series prompts state their part number; Super Series prompt states it is a Super Series and the parts it will produce
tasks.notes: IMPLEMENTED+VALIDATED (session-12, 2026-09-13): AgentPromptBuilder (Models.kt) — the app's ONLY prompt-copy surface ('Copy Agent Prompt to Clipboard' in TaskDetailScreen, awaiting_plan/complete states) — now: (1) ordinary series part N prompt header strengthened to 'SERIES MODE — THIS IS PART N OF THE SERIES "<id>" (not any other part number)' so the copied prompt explicitly states the part number (was 'this is Part N of series' — already stated it, now unmissable), production.json nested-series requirements unchanged; (2) NEW branch: when the request's series.super_series is true (same detection the TaskDetail super-plan flow uses), build() routes to buildSuperSeriesPrompt() whose text states 'SUPER SERIES MODE — THIS IS A SUPER SERIES TASK. You are planning the ENTIRE series in ONE document, not a single part. The series will be produced as multiple videos — Part 1, Part 2, Part 3, and so on through the final part — and your document defines every one of them up front.' and then spells out the super-plan contract (top-level series_id EXACT, video_duration_seconds, target_total_duration_seconds, parts array where parts[0]=Part 1 etc., per-part nested series object with part number/start/end/is_final, no-gaps-no-overlaps tiling, is_final only on the last part) — matching the pipeline's SUPER_SERIES_DIRECTIVE semantics (verified in session-11 against motionssalt/clipforge prompt.py via real CLI runs). Copy surface confirmed single: grep shows exactly one AgentPromptBuilder.build call site (TasksScreens:515) which already passes both status and request, so the super-series routing needs no call-site change. Validated: Models.kt diff is all-balanced constructs; the naive brace checker's 42/43 mismatch exists identically in the pre-change file (41/42, string-template false positive — v7 built and released with it).
